examples.text: Milhares de pessoas morreram de fome.
examples.en: Thousands of people died of hunger.

examples.text: Podemos ver milhares de estrelas no céu.
examples.en: We can see thousands of stars in the sky.

examples.text: Estimamos o dano num milhar de dólares.
examples.en: We estimate the damage at one thousand dollars.

examples.text: Milhares de pessoas morreram durante a peste.
examples.en: Thousands of people died during the plague.
